name: sqlite-catalog-contracts-history-review
goal: SQLite catalog units declare accurate readable contracts, and history-index source changes retain committed relocation review evidence.

evidence: The feature commit adds six derived SQLite/catalog function manifests and changes two previously moved history implementations. Expected behavior is declared, readable unit contracts and committed review entries tied to each changed definition while original move hashes remain intact.

The generic contract test reports missing descriptions but does not pin the six new catalog units as a group; the existing service index test detects stale definitions but the review ledger guard does not require a review when one is absent. Added focused metadata and review-ledger assertions while keeping shared test support unchanged.
